item.title: 普京威胁对西方扣押俄罗斯商船进行报复
item.description:
莫斯科（美联社）——俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京周三威胁要对西方扣押其商船进行报复，称其为“海盗行为”。
普京在访问一艘正在太平洋参加海军演习的俄罗斯军舰时发表讲话，称西方扣押与俄罗斯有联系的船只的举动违反了国际海事法。
普京说：“这只不过是海盗和抢劫。”“如果这样做，我们将被迫做出同样的回应。”
他补充说，俄罗斯的反应不一定会在俄罗斯船只被扣押的水域进行，并指出莫斯科可以“在我们认为必要和适当的任何地区”进行报复，包括太平洋。
太平洋舰队司令维克托·利纳上将向普京报告说，海军已准备好开始检查为“不友好国家”服务的商船。他指出，英国、法国和其他欧洲航空公司运营的许多船只悬挂着其他国家的国旗，实际上使它们成为“影子舰队”。
“我们有足够的资产来检查和扣留不友好国家的船只及其影子舰队，”利纳告诉普京。“我们已经准备好开始执行任务了。”
据信，俄罗斯正在利用一支由数百艘船只组成的舰队来逃避莫斯科 2022 年 2 月向乌克兰派遣军队后实施的国际制裁。
法国和英国扣押了涉嫌违反国际制裁的俄罗斯“影子舰队”运输石油的油轮。欧盟已经制裁了数百艘“影子舰队”船只。
俄罗斯最近开始部署军舰为其商船护航。
德米特里·梅德韦杰夫 (Dmitry Medvedev) 曾于 2008 年至 2012 年担任俄罗斯总统，让普京遵守任期限制，现在担任俄罗斯安理会副主席。他指出，许多欧洲航空公司的船只都像俄罗斯航空公司一样悬挂所谓的“方便旗”。
梅德韦杰夫表示：“这意味着，通过采用公平的对称方法，俄罗斯有权攻击任何属于敌对国家的商船，无论是在我们的水域还是在中立水域，只要有合理的理由怀疑它正在为敌人的利益运送货物，这适用于任何货物。”“这样的船只有很多，我们的军队有能力将行动大幅扩展到黑海盆地以外。”

item.title: 泽伦斯基称，乌克兰一夜之间的闪电战摧毁了俄罗斯黑海海军据点
item.description:
KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — Ukrainian anti-ship missiles and drones blitzed a major Russian naval base on the Black Sea coast in a “unique” nighttime operation, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Wednesday.
Cutting-edge dronesdeveloped by Kyiv sinceMoscow’s full-scale invasionover four years ago have repeatedly targeted Russian ships in the Black Sea, including warships andoil tankers.
Ukraine’sair and sea droneshave succeeded in limiting the movements of Russia’s once-dominant Black Sea navy, Kyiv officials say, in one of the country’s biggest accomplishments of the war.
But Ukrainian officials believe Russian President Vladimir Putin is bent on pressing ahead with the war, despite his bigger army’s slow and costly progress on the battlefield and U.S. diplomatic efforts to find a settlement.
Putin is planning “an additional rapid mobilization of several hundred thousand Russians by the end of the year,” Zelenskyy said Tuesday night on social media, citing Ukrainian intelligence reports.
Those reports have said recently that Russia is expanding production of ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones, both of which are hard for Ukrainian air defenses to counter.
Ukraine also is trying to scale up its weapons manufacturing through agreements with partner countries.
Neither Putin nor other senior Russian officials have hinted at a possible major call-up of forces to fight in Ukraine. Some officials have accused Kyiv of trying to rattle the Russian public with talk of a mobilization.
Russian lawmaker Andrei Gurulyov brushed off reports of a possible autumn mobilization. “It is the enemy deliberately spreading rumors about mobilization in order to destabilize the situation inside Russia,” he was quoted as saying by pro-Kremlin online outlet Tsargrad in comments published Monday.
After the widely unpopular partial mobilization of some 300,000 men four years ago, Russia has relied on volunteers attracted by relatively high pay. However, the decree declaring the partial mobilization that Putin signed in September 2022 is open-ended, allowing authorities to resume it if needed.
The Ukrainian military “carried out a unique operation targeting the naval base in Novorossiysk — the last major stronghold of the Russian fleet in the Black Sea,” Zelenskyy said in a social media post Wednesday. The attack struck air defenses, piers and other port infrastructure, he added.
Russia relocated most of its naval ships to Novorossiysk after Ukrainian strikes on the main Black Sea base at Sevastopol on the Crimean Peninsula earlier in the war.
Hundreds of Ukrainian drones attacked Novorossiysk, Anapa and Gelendzhik and the Temryuk district of the Krasnodar region overnight, said Gov. Veniamin Kondratyev.
An 8-year-old child was one of three people killed in the attack on the region, Kondratyev said. He added that 24 others in the region were wounded. Dozens of residential buildings were damaged, Kondratyev said, and debris from downed drones fell on the grounds of four industrial plants.
The strikes damaged two of Novorossiysk’s three grain terminals, with one of them halting operations, the Russian business daily Vedomosti reported.
Russia’s Defense Ministry said its air defenses downed more than 500 Ukrainian drones.
Novorossiysk also is home to the Grushovaya oil terminal, one of the largest international hubs in southern Russia for petroleum products. No reports indicated it had been hit.
In February, the U.S. State Departmentexpressed its displeasureabout Ukraine’s attacks on Novorossiysk, saying they affected U.S. oil interests in ⁠Kazakhstan.
The Caspian Pipeline Consortium operates a pipeline from the Caspian coast in northwestern Kazakhstan to Novorossiysk. The pipeline handles much of the crude exports from three major Kazakh fields in which major U.S. energy companies, Chevron and ExxonMobil, have stakes.
With the militaries of European countriesboarding and detainingsanctioned Russian oil tankers at sea, hurting the country’s trade and heaping economic pressure on Moscow, Putin on Wednesday threatened retaliation for what he termed “piracy.”
Speaking on avisit to a Russian warshiptaking part in a naval exercise in the Pacific, Putin said Western countries are breaking international maritime law by seizing ships they say are part of Moscow’s “shadow fleet” of sanctions-dodging merchant vessels.
“It’s nothing but piracy and robbery,” Putin said. “If this is done, we will be forced to respond in kind.”
On the Crimean Peninsula, which was illegally annexed by Moscow in 2014, air defenses downed 115 Ukrainian drones over Sevastopol overnight, said Mikhail Razvozhayev, the city’s Russian-installed head. He added that 10 apartment buildings and 25 private houses were damaged.
Ukraine’s air force said Russia fired 138 long-range drones as well as an unspecified number of missiles during the night, with damage recorded at 16 locations.
In the Kherson region of southern Ukraine, a large-scale Russian drone attack overnight killed two people and wounded two others, said regional head Oleksandr Prokudin.
The attacks also destroyed a shopping mall in the southern city of Zaporizhzhia, according to authorities.
Missiles and long-range drones hit fuel reservoirs and infrastructure used for unloading and storing military cargo in the port of Chornomorsk in Ukraine’s Odesa region, Russia’s Defense Ministry said.
A bulk cargo vessel carrying military equipment and a tanker loaded with oil for the Ukrainian armed forces also were hit in Odesa, it said.
Follow the AP’s coverage of the war in Ukraine athttps://apnews.com/hub/russia-ukraine

item.title: 美联社独家报道：ICE 计划向警员提供可带来痛苦电击的手套
item.description:
移民和海关执法人员可能很快就会配备可以发出痛苦电击的手套，以博取好斗个人的服从。
根据国土安全部周一发布的公告，ICE 计划在 3 月份之前斥资 2000 万美元为官员和特工购买数千个“传导干扰和降级装置”。
这些器件被称为 G.L.O.V.E.，代表生成低输出电压发射器，由肯塔基州列克星敦的 Compliant Technologies LLC 制造。近年来，一些监狱和警察部门已使用它们。
国土安全部周二表示，正在对美联社的调查做出回应，但没有立即发表评论。Compliant Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官杰夫·尼克劳斯 (Jeff Niklaus) 在一封电子邮件中写道，“不幸的是，我们无法谈论这个话题。”
该通知称，无投标合同招标最早可能于周五发布。
民权倡导者对该计划表示震惊，称ICE官员在执行唐纳德·特朗普总统的移民镇压行动时，已经因在缺乏监督或问责的情况下使用武力而受到批评。
Compliant Technologies 表示，这些设备的功能就像一副普通的巡逻手套，直到警察按下开关激活其电动模式。该公司表示，手套必须直接戴在某人的皮肤上，以产生疼痛刺激，通常可以帮助警官在几秒钟内获得服从。
“它是直接的、尖锐的，而且会分散你的注意力。我称其为蜜蜂蜇伤，”正在研究该装置如何使用的预防羁押死亡研究所所长约翰·彼得斯 (John Peters) 说。“如果警官受到此人任何类型的抵抗，这无疑是一个有效的工具。”
彼得斯表示，他相信 ICE 计划的收购可能是该公司迄今为止规模最大的一笔收购。他说，他可以想象 ICE 官员会使用这款手套来帮助将不合作的对象从汽车和房屋中以及进出拘留设施中移走。
他说，“对于规模较小的警官、实力较弱的警官或年长的警官来说，我认为它具有很大的优势”，因为它可以更快地击倒敌人并缩短对抗时间。
制造商警告说，该设备不应用作惩罚，针对仅表现出“口头反抗或好战”的人，或针对儿童、孕妇、老年人或残疾人等高危人群。
美国公民自由联盟警务项目副主任 Jenn Rolnick Borchetta 表示，公众不应相信 ICE 官员会正确使用这些设备。她质疑为什么这些设备对于民事移民执法是必要的，并指出那些感到震惊的人可能没有提前收到警告。
“去年，ICE 向这个国家表明，他们使用武力的速度太快了。现在，他们只需轻轻按一下按钮就可以实施电击，也许其他人都看不到他们这样做，”她说。“引入很容易在遭遇中造成可怕疼痛的手套，会伤害公众。”
支持者表示，这些设备通常用于特定的监狱和运输情况，而不是广泛用于街道巡逻。据 Compliant Technologies 称，它们被用来制服拒绝进入警车的暴力嫌疑人以及自残和威胁警察的囚犯。
彼得斯表示，他预计这些设备会像其他警务技术一样被少数员工滥用，但他表示它们不太可能造成伤害。他表示，对于 ICE 来说，制定强有力的政策和培训非常重要。
制造商表示，要使用该设备，官员必须完成课程并每两年重新获得一次认证。

item.title: 约翰·高蒂的孙子一直试图推迟入狱时间，为母亲捐献肾脏。法官说够了
item.description:
纽约（美联社）——已故黑帮老大约翰·戈蒂的电视真人秀明星孙子在试图逃避欺诈指控的判决后，向联邦监狱报到，他说他将向生病的母亲维多利亚·戈蒂捐献一个肾脏。
联邦监狱局周二证实，卡米内·阿格内洛 (Carmine Agnello) 于前一天在新泽西州南部费尔顿联邦惩教所开始了 15 个月的监禁。
阿涅洛曾在 2000 年代中期出演过《Growing Up Gotti》，原定于 7 月到监狱报到。但美国地方法院法官努斯拉特·乔杜里 (Nusrat Choudhury) 同意将手术推迟到 9 月 18 日，并表示这将留出足够的时间从手术中恢复，并假设手术如阿涅洛 (Agnello) 所建议的那样在 8 月 10 日之前发生。
阿涅洛的律师在法庭文件中表示，纽约甘比诺犯罪家族前头目的女儿维多利亚·戈蒂患有慢性肾病。
不过，周一，由于看不到任何行动，乔杜里命令阿涅洛立即向联邦当局自首。
法官表示：“由于没有具体证据表明从今天到 2026 年 9 月 18 日期间的任何时间都会安排器官移植，因此要求再次推迟阿涅洛先生的自首是不合理的。”
阿涅洛的律师罗伯特·贝尔特拉尼在一封信中表示，外科医生需要更多时间来确定手术日期，因为戈蒂正在处理感染问题。
“毫无疑问，卡米恩与戈蒂女士是绝配，”他说。“他只是请求法庭允许他在这段非常有限的时间内继续陪伴他的母亲，同时她的医生决定她是否以及何时可以进行移植。”
检察官表示反对，指出被告信中所附的一份医疗报告称，医生正在努力“查明戈蒂反复感染的病因和适当的治疗方法”，在得到充分治疗之前不会进行移植。
“显然，移植手术不会迫在眉睫，”纽约东区联邦检察官约瑟夫·诺切拉说。
诺切拉的办公室拒绝进一步置评，阿涅洛的律师也没有立即回复电子邮件。作家兼《纽约邮报》前专栏作家戈蒂也没有这样做。
阿涅洛于 2024 年承认犯有电汇欺诈罪，此前检察官表示，他从一项旨在在 COVID-19 大流行期间帮助小企业的联邦计划中欺诈性地获得了 110 万美元的贷款。
检察官称，他是长岛居民，代表他的公司 Crown Auto Parts & Recycling LLC 获得了贷款，但在该公司雇用了多少人、他的犯罪记录和资金计划方面撒了谎。
检察官称，在阿涅洛申请贷款之前，该公司已停止运营，他最终将这笔贷款用于其他企业，包括对加密货币业务的 42 万美元投资。
现年 40 岁的阿涅洛十几岁的时候，他和他的兄弟们在讲述一家人在长岛生活的《Growing up Gotti》中因留着发胶发型而短暂出名。
他的祖父因其华丽的风格和多年来所面临的一些刑事指控的能力而赢得了“特氟龙唐”和“衣冠楚楚的唐”的绰号。2002 年，他死于密苏里州联邦监狱，享年 61 岁。
阿涅洛现在被关押的新泽西州看守所多年来关押了一些著名的囚犯。
最近名誉扫地的前纽约众议员乔治·桑托斯 (George Santos) 在纽约被判七年多刑期，服刑还不到三个月，直到去年唐纳德·特朗普总统才给予他宽大处理。
关注菲利普·马塞洛 https://x.com/philmarcelo

item.title: 特朗普表示，由于威胁，特勤局和军方希望他离开土耳其的空军一号
item.description:
WASHINGTON (AP) — PresidentDonald Trumpsaid Tuesday that heslipped away from Air Force Oneafter a trip last month in Turkey because the Secret Service and military wanted him on a “different plane” due to a threat that he insisted didn’t scare him.
Trump downplayed the extraordinary nature of the subterfuge involved in his flight, which saw him stow away in an airport catering container to sneak onto another plane while Air Force One was sent into the sky, essentially as a decoy.
He also downplayed the risk to the people — White House officials, security and support staff, and reporters — he left on the plane.
“They wanted me to go on a different flight, different plane,” Trump told reporters after returning from an event in Ohio, saying he had little choice in the matter.
“I guess there was a threat out there. I didn’t really ask too much about it,” he said. “I get a lot of threats.”
His comments confirmed a report that first appeared in The Washington Post saying that Trump, following aNATO summitlast month, was spirited onto a different plane because of a credible threat from Iran. The action was kept secret for weeks, until the newspaper’s story.
“I think actually the plane that I flew on was at greater risk,” Trump said Tuesday, who did not provide many details about the action. But he said the incident did not scare him.
“I don’t worry about anything, to be honest,” Trump said. “Whatever it is. You know my attitude? Whatever!”
Commanders in chief have sometimes keptoverseas tripscovert for security reasons, with schedules and logistics kept classified until after for safety reasons. But the fact that Trump’s whereabouts were concealed at the time and for weeks afterward is believed to be unprecedented.
“We have absolutely seen the president fly on unmarked or decoy planes before, into Iraq, Afghanistan, other war-zone-like places,” said Garrett M. Graff, author of “Raven Rock: The Story of the U.S. Government’s Secret Plan to Save Itself — While the Rest of Us Die.”
“But this was an ongoing secret that I don’t think we’ve ever seen before.”
After hiding in the catering vehicle and being moved to the other plane, Trump stopped in Britain, sneaked back aboard the presidential plane undetected, and even later scoffed when asked about potential danger.
“If I go, you go. Right?” he told reporters then — gliding past the fact that if the plane had been shot down, the president wouldn’t have been aboard.
The president’s flight out of Turkeymade headlines at the timebecause he had arrived aboard a luxury jetgifted by Qatar,whichwas not equippedwith some of the same missile detection and countermeasure systems found on older presidential jets.
Trump ended up traveling in a smaller government aircraft from Turkey to the United Kingdom, only to secretly reboard the decoy jet, then descend from it and climb back aboard the Qatari plane.
Presidents have regularly tested the confines of their office, pushing their security advisers to visit war zones as a show of American presence and their own leadership. Usually, this happens in the form of trips that aren’t announced until the president is deemed to be out of harm’s way.
What’s different this time is that Trump was covertly separated from the rest of his travelers — including the press pool meant to provide independent coverage of the president and his actions — and, instead of informing the public about what occurred once the risk had passed, the White House still hasn’t fully revealed what took place.
Graff said the presence of the White House press corps is as much about protecting “the presidency and democracy” as it is about covering the story.
“This shows that the White House just fundamentally doesn’t understand how important that role is,” he said.
In 2023, a motorcade pulled away from the White Housearound 3:30 a.m. on a Sunday, and PresidentJoe Bidenlater boarded an Air Force C-32, a modified Boeing 757 normally used for domestic trips to smaller airports, and flew to Poland. Biden then took a secret, 10-hour overnight train ride to Kyiv meant to show solidarity with Ukraine after Russia’s invasion.
A press pool at the White House had been expecting a quiet Sunday for Biden in Washington. However, two journalists went to Ukraine with him and documented the trip, capturing images of Biden and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy walking together.
In Trump’s first term, he made a secret Thanksgiving trip to Afghanistan in 2019, when officials kept a separate press pool and decoy plane in Florida to maintain the illusion that the president was spending the holiday at his Mar-a-Lago estate.
Instead, Trump and another group of reporters flew to the U.S. military base at Bagram, where the president served turkey to troops, gave a speech and met with Afghanistan’s then-president, Ashraf Ghani, while journalists documented what was occurring.
When President George W. Bush made his first trip to Iraq in 2003, news was not released until he was in the air on the way back to the United States. President Barack Obama made a furtive nighttime visit to Afghanistan in 2010, when he was meant to be spending the weekend at Camp David.
President Bill Clinton went secretly from India to Pakistan in 2000, attempting to calm tensions in the disputed Kashmir region. He was seen talking with officials in front of a military plane that he appeared to board. Instead, Clinton ducked around the front of the aircraft to another jet parked nearby.
Both planes took off for Islamabad, as did a third jet painted with the familiar baby blue markings of Air Force One.
Joe Lockhart, a White House press secretary for Clinton, noted that reporters knew the president was on one of the planes, “but not which one.” He said he and other officials had briefed the press pool ahead of time and “although they didn’t know all the details, it was made clear” that Clinton “was not going to travel on the plane they were on.
“There was no attempt to hide anything, much less lie about it later,” Lockhart wrote on social media.
Bush was visiting an elementary school in Sarasota, Florida, during the Sept. 11 attacks in 2001, and, after all commercial air traffic was grounded, officials wanted to move him to an undisclosed location.
The full White House traveling press pool flew with Bush from Florida to Barksdale Air Force Base in Louisiana, where officials reduced the number of reporters and staff on the plane. Bush and the smaller traveling party next flew to Nebraska’s Offutt Air Force Base before eventually returning to Washington.
Bush’s location remained secret throughout the day. However, the White House did not suggest that the president was somewhere he was not — unlike when Trump was whisked out of Turkey.
“You can imagine the different ways that this could have gone wrong, where, for a period of time, no one would have been able to independently corroborate the status of the U.S. president, or who was in charge of the U.S. government,” Graff said. “And that’s an incredibly dangerous moment for the world.”

item.title: 阿肯色州高中橄榄球运动员头盔中藏着一条毒蛇进行训练
item.description:
阿肯色州莫梅勒（美联社）——阿肯色州的一名高中橄榄球运动员在训练时发现头盔里有一条毒蛇，他完全有理由感到惊慌。
上周热身后，这名莫梅勒高中的学生感到头盔内部有异常运动，于是将头盔交给助理教练检查。在一些衬垫后面发现了一条滑行的 2 英尺长的棉口鱼。
响尾蛇非常不愿意退出头盔，动物管理人员不得不将头盔浸入水中，然后用钳子夹住它，将蛇推出来。动物服务技术人员确认这条蛇是致命的棉口蛇。它被释放到树林繁茂的地区。
棉口蛇是阿肯色州发现的第二毒蛇。
动物服务主管克里斯·戴维斯表示，这名球员戴着头盔近一个小时，幸运的是他没有被咬。
“这太不真实了，”戴维斯说。“你必须亲临现场并拍照才能证明这是真的。”
这名球员抓起了不同的头盔，继续练习。但这种情况导致主教练向他的团队重申，球员在使用他们的装备之前应该仔细检查，检查是否有昆虫——或者可能是更大、更危险的东西。

item.title: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多和乔治娜·罗德里格斯十年后喜结良缘
item.description:
克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多和乔治娜·罗德里格斯是夫妻。
他们周二在一场民事仪式上结婚，这位葡萄牙足球明星的公关团队将其形容为“一个私人而亲密的时刻，他们的五个孩子都参加了”。
不伦瑞克集团在公告中表示，仪式在葡萄牙西部首都里斯本附近的沿海小镇卡斯卡伊斯举行。
这对夫妇在他们的 Instagram 账户上发布了一张展示戒指的照片。
他们在马德里相遇后已经在一起十年了。
41 岁的罗纳尔多曾五次获得年度世界足球先生，也是最引人注目的体育明星之一，他即将代表葡萄牙第六次参加世界杯，这将打破纪录。
他的沙特球队 Al Nassr 将于周六开始其国内赛季。

item.title: 美联社消息人士称，乔什·库什纳和鲍勃·艾格同意购买湖人队，这笔价值 12.5B 美元的重磅交易
item.description:
LOS ANGELES (AP) —The Los Angeles Lakersare being sold for the second time in a year, going to businessmen Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for a record-breaking price.
This sale agreement is $12.5 billion, according to a person familiar with the terms who spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity Wednesday because neither side revealed specific details of the latest stunning development with one of North America’s marquee sports teams.
ESPN first reported that Kushner and Iger are buying the NBA’s most valuable franchise. The Lakers were valued last year at $10 billion — a record for a pro sports team — when Mark Walter purchased acontrolling stake from the Buss family, which had owned the team since 1979.
“As lifelong NBA fans, we are deeply honored for the opportunity to become stewards of the Los Angeles Lakers, one of the most iconic sports franchises in the world,” Iger and Kushner said in a statement. “We have immense respect for the leadership and vision of Jerry and Jeanie Buss. Our long-term commitment is to build on that foundation, compete at the highest level, and serve this extraordinary team, its fans, and the city of Los Angeles.”
Kushner, a venture capitalist, and former Walt Disney Company CEO Iger had been working together on landing a possible NBA expansion team for Las Vegas. By buying the Lakers, they don’t have to wait until the possibility of expansion in the 2028-29 season at the earliest.
Lakers icon Magic Johnson, a partner in Walter’s ownership of baseball’s Los Angeles Dodgers, praised the deal on social media.
“Laker fans, you couldn’t have two better owners,” Johnson wrote. “I’ve known Bob personally for over 40 years — he has always loved the Lakers and basketball and he will bring championships back to LA.”
The sale still will need approval from the NBA’s board of governors, and that process can take several weeks. The next board meeting is set for September in New York.
The $12.5 billion price tag is not only a record for U.S. pro sports but a new summit in skyrocketing NBA franchise values. Only three years ago,Michael Jordan sold his majority stake in the Charlotte Hornetsfor a $3 billion valuation, while theBoston Celtics were sold last year to private equity mogul Bill Chisholmat a valuation of just over $6 billion.
Walter’s agreement to purchase acontrolling stakein the Lakers at the $10 billion valuation last summer obliterated that mark, and now Iger and Kushner have pushed the bar even higher.
The 66-year-old Walter’s shocking decision to sell after just 10 months of official ownership is reverberating throughout the team’s massive fan base, which appeared to be uniformly excited about the purchase last year. Walter has stewardedthe Dodgersinto the most successful stretch in franchise history, with three World Series championships in the past six seasons as the most aggressive spenders in baseball.
Multiple media outlets last month reported that Walter’s business empire is under scrutiny from both federal prosecutors and the Securities and Exchange Commission in tax fraud investigations.
The Lakers are 17-time NBA champions who won their most recent title in 2020. They’ve made the playoffs in each of the past four seasons, and their current roster is built around NBA scoring champion Luka Doncic, who is signed through the 2028-29 season. The Slovenian superstar has become passionate about Los Angeles and the Lakers less than two years after his arrival.
“Being a Laker means everything to me, and I’m excited to get back on the court and bring a championship to LA,” Doncic wrote on social media after hearing of the sale. “I’ve gotten used to big changes over these last few years, but I know that no matter what, there is no limit to the potential of this iconic franchise. I look forward to meeting Josh and Bob so we can get to work building something special in LA together.”
The 41-year-old Kushner has been a minority owner of two NBA teams, but he jumped into the international sports spotlight this summer when his capital holding company, Thrive Eternal, was set to be the “anchor investor” inFIFA President Gianni Infantino’s planto sell stakes in future World Cup profits. Infantinoabandoned the ideaon July 31.
Kushner’s older brother isJared Kushner, son-in-law of U.S. President Donald Trump.
Josh Kushner currently owns a minority stake in the Miami Heat, and he previously owned a stake in the Memphis Grizzlies.
The 75-year-old Iger became one of Hollywood’s most well-known executives while he ran Disney for two lengthy stints between 2005 and last March, when he stepped aside. Iger and his wife, former sports journalist Willow Bay, became the controlling owners of NWSL team Angel City FC in 2024 with a deal that valued the club at $250 million.
Walter’s purchase of the Lakers was approved by NBA owners last October. He originally bought a 27% minority stake in the team in 2021 before purchasing control of the team last year.
The Lakers’ 17 championships going back to the franchise’s origin in Minneapolis are the second-most in NBA history behind Boston’s 18. It is a global brand, always at or near the top of the league’s merchandise-sales rankings.
This record sale price comes just weeks after LeBron James, the league’s all-time leading scorer, left the Lakers after eight seasons to become a free agent.James ultimately decidedto sign with the Philadelphia 76ers.
Walter and his team had already begun to make extensive changes to the Lakers, who were often perceived as an antiquated franchise in many aspects during their decades of Buss family ownership.
The Lakers had beefed up their basketball operations department with new hires in the front office around longtime general manager Rob Pelinka. They also boosted the business side with extensive searches for new revenue, including sales of new jersey patches and additional prominent sponsorship deals.
When Walter bought his controlling interest in the Lakers, the deal specified that Jeanie Buss would stay on as the team’s governor. With new ownership, it’s unclear whether Buss will have a continuing role in the team she inherited along with her siblings from her father, Jerry Buss, who died in 2013.
Along with the Dodgers, Walter and his various partners also have ownership interests in the WNBA’s Los Angeles Sparks, English Premier League club Chelsea, the Professional Women’s Hockey League and the new Cadillac Formula 1 racing team.
AP Basketball Writer Tim Reynolds in Miami contributed to this report.

item.title: 新起诉书称尼克·雷纳在杀害父母罗布·雷纳和米歇尔·雷纳之前埋伏
item.description:
洛杉矶（美联社）——洛杉矶县大陪审团对尼克·雷纳伦（Nick Reineron）谋杀父母罗布·雷纳（Rob Reiner）和米歇尔·辛格·雷纳（Michele Singer Reiner）提出谋杀指控，并补充说他在袭击他们之前就已经埋伏。
秘密开会的大陪审团于 7 月 20 日返回了起诉书，并于周三启封，当时 32 岁的尼克·雷纳 (Nick Reiner) 提出无罪抗辩。
12 月 14 日，导演、演员、好莱坞明星罗布·莱纳 (Rob Reiner) 和他的摄影师兼制片人妻子在洛杉矶布伦特伍德高档区的家中被刺死。尼克·莱纳 (Nick Reiner) 在几小时内被捕，两天后被指控。
大陪审团的起诉书是朝着审判迈出的重要一步，并允许检察官跳过加州的初步听证程序，证据将被公开播放。
埋伏是指嫌疑人等待或躲避受害者，以便伏击他们，作为一项指控，这意味着有预谋。如果发现他正在等待并被判谋杀罪，那么莱纳就有资格被判处死刑，但检察官表示，他们尚未决定是否寻求死刑。
洛杉矶县地方检察官内森·霍奇曼在一份声明中说：“这是一个深深的背叛，他被指控杀害的人所爱和信任。”“我们希望大陪审团就本案返回起诉书，这将使我们离审判和伸张正义更近一步。”
检察官对可能的动机只字不提，双方几乎都不存在泄密的情况。
洛杉矶县首席法医告诉美联社，他希望公开尸检报告，但法院命令阻止他这样做。
未密封的起诉书几乎没有透露这起案件的新细节。它没有解释莱纳如何或为何埋伏等待。检察官自去年 12 月起就表示父母被刺伤，但没有详细说明。起诉书包括一项关于使用致命武器（一把刀）的特殊指控，这也可能导致更严厉的判决。
起诉书发布之际，莱纳正在向他父母为他设立的信托基金索要未付款项，称他需要这笔钱来帮助他辩护。
赖纳在一份法庭请愿书中表示，监督这些资金的受托人在没有法律依据的情况下拒绝向他提供这些资金。法律文件称，即使尼克·雷纳的父母还活着，这笔钱也会归他所有。请愿书称，该信托基金至少拥有 150 万美元的资产，但受托人不愿透露具体数额。
请愿书称：“尼克爱他的父母，他对他们的去世感到悲痛。但关于他们身上发生过什么和没有发生过什么的事实并不存在问题。”
他正在寻求重新聘请备受瞩目的刑事辩护律师艾伦·杰克逊(Alan Jackson)，在莱纳的兄弟姐妹不再同意为他的辩护提供资金并由一名公设辩护人接手之前，艾伦·杰克逊最初是他的代理律师。
请愿书的听证会定于下周举行。
代表莱纳的洛杉矶县公设辩护人办公室拒绝对起诉书发表评论。
加州检察官可以对被告提出指控，并通过初步听证会审理此案，这是一种微型审判，证据会公开播放，由法官决定是否应将其送交审判，正如歌手 D4vd 最近发生的那样。
或者他们可以利用大陪审团秘密地完成整个过程。他们还可以公开提出指控，然后寻求大陪审团的秘密起诉书，本质上是创建一个新版本的案件，就像这里和洛杉矶起诉哈维·韦恩斯坦的情况一样。
罗布·雷纳 (Rob Reiner) 最初是一名演员，在电视情景喜剧《全家福》中饰演迈克尔·“肉头”·斯蒂维奇 (Michael “Meathead” Stivic)，他是卡罗尔·奥康纳 (Carroll O’Connor) 饰演的更为保守和偏执的阿奇·邦克 (Archie Bunker) 的自由派女婿。莱纳因这个角色获得了两项艾美奖，上个月还因在《熊》中客串出演而获得艾美奖提名。
他成为了一位多产的导演，其作品包括一些 20 世纪 80 年代和 90 年代最令人难忘、永不停歇的电影。他的作品包括《This is Spinal Tap》、《Stand By Me》、《A Few Good Men》和《When Harry Met Sally...》，在制作过程中他结识了摄影师米歇尔·辛格。他们很快就结婚了，结婚已有36年。
尼克·雷纳 (Nick Reiner) 是他们三个孩子中的第二个。他和父亲共同撰写了 2015 年电影《成为查理》(Being Charlie) 的剧本，该片的部分内容是基于儿子青少年时期与毒瘾和无家可归的斗争。
他的哥哥杰克·雷纳（Jake Reiner）在四月份写道，失去父母和以弟弟为中心的经历是“一场活生生的噩梦”，“毁灭性太严重，难以理解”。

item.title: 罗德·斯图尔特爵士在冠状动脉支架手术后取消了剩余的巡演日期
item.description:
纽约（美联社）——罗德·斯图尔特爵士的一位代表证实，在接受冠状动脉支架手术以及推迟和取消几场演出后，罗德·斯图尔特爵士将无法继续他的“最后一次”告别巡演。
斯图尔特在推迟周日在辛辛那提河湾音乐中心举行的音乐会后不久，取消了周二晚上在克利夫兰火箭竞技场的演出。后者当时表示，这是由于“意外但轻微的医疗程序，需要立即关注”。
斯图尔特今年早些时候还取消了一些约会，其中包括拉斯维加斯的两次和圣地亚哥的一次。
“经过进一步的医疗评估，罗德·斯图尔特爵士成功接受了常规冠状动脉支架手术。医生对他的康复情况感到满意，罗德状况良好，已经恢复了正常的日常活动，”他的公关人员在一份声明中写道。“根据医生的建议，他将在接下来的四个星期内康复并恢复完全健康，然后再重返舞台。不幸的是，这意味着他将无法继续当前的巡演日期。”
它补充说，“有关受影响演出的信息将由各自的主办方和场馆传达。”
现年 81 岁的斯图尔特原定于 9 月 3 日在北美露面，其中包括在拉斯维加斯凯撒宫斗兽场的六晚驻场演出以及在墨西哥的几次约会。
斯图尔特在声明中说：“我已经感觉好多了，正在好转。我要感谢医生、护士和所有给予我如此精心照顾的人。”“我对错过这些演出深感失望，也很抱歉让我的粉丝们失望，但我期待很快回到舞台上，再次与大家一起度过美好时光。”
格莱美奖得主斯图尔特以其标志性的锉刀使他成为摇滚乐传奇人物，在他的职业生涯数十年中已售出数百万张唱片。他最著名的歌曲可能是《Maggie May》和《Tonight’s the Night》，他曾两次入选摇滚名人堂。

item.title: 电影评论：“橡树街的尽头”是一个奇闻趣事的好时光
item.description:
在大卫·罗伯特·米切尔的《橡树街的尽头》中，街区的尽头是一条死胡同，中间有一根电线杆，电线像大陀螺的电缆一样向外辐射。对于一部采用复古表演技巧制作的惊险狂欢电影来说，这是一个恰当的处理方式。
当然，夏季电影并不以缺乏马戏团般的混乱而闻名。但 8 月中旬上映的这部以 1980 年代为背景的电影《橡树街的尽头》的一大亮点在于，它吸收了安布林风格的大片精神，并在没有眨眼的讽刺或繁琐的致敬的情况下，让人联想到一场看似专为汽车影院设计的夏季刺激之旅。
米切尔的突破是 2014 年精彩的恐怖片《它追随》，随后他又推出了一部雄心勃勃却又毛茸茸的自我放纵的洛杉矶新黑色电影《银湖之下》。但《橡树街的尽头》讲述了 1980 年代郊区家庭的故事，他们的社区穿越了时间，其中的任何放纵都是为了观众。《橡树街的尽头》是一场疯狂的爆炸。
最好对电影的曲折一无所知，所以请仔细阅读这篇评论的其余部分。这并不是说，从中央家庭开始，《橡树街的尽头》的大部分内容都不是立即熟悉的。
普拉茨一家住在看起来像圣费尔南多谷的社区，到处都是错层和整洁的小街道。丹妮丝（安妮·海瑟薇饰）和格雷格（伊万·麦克格雷格饰）有两个孩子和一只名叫星巴克的狗。奥黛丽（麦西·斯特拉饰）是一名青少年，布莱恩（克里斯蒂安·康弗里饰）是她的弟弟。
但从我们在社区集市上见到他们的那一刻起，他们的美国生活就出现了明显的裂痕。格雷格（Greg）正在做一份送披萨的副业，而丹妮丝（Denise）正在秘密打字一本可能是励志小说，讲述一个女人梦想离开家人的故事。孩子们也有自己的秘密。他们怀疑父母即将离婚，格雷格和丹尼斯似乎也是如此。
这样的科幻灾难框架自然就是斯皮尔伯格101。不过，虽然《橡树街的尽头》肯定会考验和恢复他们的家庭纽带，但剧本的编剧米切尔却采取了一条更倾向于恐怖、荒诞和彻头彻尾的愚蠢的路线。
无论如何，是的，有恐龙。米切尔挑逗他们的方式既熟练又有趣。最初的迹象是神秘的。一道光芒闪过。邻居后院有一朵奇怪的异国花。别人身上有大量粪便。但很快，普拉特一家就发现他们的社区到处都是原始野兽，周围都是丛林：橡树街突然变成了史前世界中的一座郊区岛屿。
这是一个完美的《暮光之城》情节，无意间解决了困扰《侏罗纪公园》电影20年的问题。如果说这些电影都在努力寻找岛外的背景，那么《橡树街的尽头》却将恐龙岛直接带入了郊区。与猛禽的遭遇以及更糟糕的事情发生在前廊和长毛地毯上。
你可以把这一切归结为愚蠢的乐趣。主要是这样的，布景是为了让观众在期待中呻吟或为大锤的成功挥舞而欢呼。但《橡树街的尽头》的成功之处在于它对人物的真诚，而其他许多作品却失败了。普氏能源资讯的理念虽然荒唐可笑，但却是有根有据的。（尤其是海瑟薇，在这方面提供了帮助。） 一部严肃的家庭剧与电脑特效的狂欢相结合，再加上越来越疯狂的情节，使《橡树街的尽头》成为一部相当不间断的电影。
作曲家迈克尔·贾基诺 (Michael Giacchino) 尽其所能地配合了约翰·威廉姆斯 (John Williams) 的风格。但米切尔的电影也越来越偏离斯皮尔伯格的剧本。只有米切尔会花点时间让吓坏了的奥黛丽溜进车里，放一盘磁带，听史蒂夫·温伍德的《瓦莱丽》。
虽然它会推动它说“橡树街的尽头”下面有很多东西，但它的角色们团结一致，对某些事情保密，因为担心他们的配偶、孩子或父母无法处理真相。恐龙入侵邻居的速度之快可能是任何生态灾难的象征，但随后的挑战证明，每个家庭成员都能应对比预期更多的事情——即使父母保证一切都会好起来的，就像一条巨蛇在他们家中滑行时，是可笑的、有争议的。
这给老派的家庭冒险增添了一种更黑暗、更现代的色彩，营造出一段奇闻趣事的美好时光。米切尔很快就将郊区作为他的明显领地，“它”或其他东西肯定会随之而来。
华纳兄弟周四在影院上映的《橡树街的尽头》因一些强烈的暴力内容、血腥画面、一些粗俗语言和暗示性材料而被美国电影协会评为 PG-13。运行时间：99分钟。四颗星中的三颗星。

item.title: 埃德蒙兹表示，明年不会出现的汽车
item.description:
每年都有少量车辆停产。对于购车者来说，这些取消很少成为新闻。但如果您知道去哪里寻找，就有机会以优惠价格买到生命周期即将结束的车辆。
经销商很有可能会寻求出售已停产车辆的剩余库存，这可以为您提供谈判价格的机会。打折车辆也有可能在多年后成为高价值的经典车型。Edmunds 的汽车专家重点介绍了 2026 年之后不会出现的五款最著名车型。以下所有价格均包含目的地费用。
经过 25 年和四代的发展，Escape 即将离开经销商展厅。福特的小型 SUV 并不能完全与现代途胜和丰田 RAV4 等顶级竞争对手相媲美，但它有足够的积极属性值得考虑，特别是如果你能以折扣价买到一辆的话。
Escape 拥有舒适的座椅、平稳的乘坐质量和易于使用的控制装置。它还配备两种动力系统，可帮助您节省汽油：混合动力车可提供 EPA 估计的 39 英里/加仑的综合油耗，或插电式混合动力车，在切换到燃气发动机之前，可在全电力驱动下行驶 37 英里。
ID.4 是 2021 年发布的首批挑战特斯拉 Model Y 的电动 SUV 之一。其充足的行驶里程和一长串的标准功能使其成为电动汽车的可行选择，但随着时间的推移，ID.4 已被现代 Ioniq 5 等竞争对手超越，或者被雪佛兰 Equinox EV 等较便宜的选择压低价格。
然而，选择 2026 ID.4 是很有意义的。根据 Edmunds 对交易数据的分析，您可能会比标价节省约 10,000 美元。为了发挥 2026 ID.4 的最佳价值，请查看配备标准后轮驱动的 Pro 装饰。它配备了加热前排座椅、无线充电、12.9 英寸触摸屏和多种驾驶员辅助功能。
如果您曾经梦想拥有一辆新捷豹，那么 2026 款 F-Pace 是您购买汽油动力版本的最后机会，因为该公司正在向全电动超豪华品牌转型。F-Pace 是捷豹过去的最后一款内燃机车型，并且不会被取代。
尽管 F-Pace 已经服役了 10 年没有重新设计，但它仍然拥有有吸引力的设计、强大的可选发动机和敏锐的操控性。捷豹无法与较新的小型豪华 SUV 完全竞争，但获得优惠可能足以吸引您。作为未来潜在的经典车型，请查看以性能为导向的 SVR 575 版，它配备了强大的 567 马力 V8 发动机。
GR Supra 是丰田的旗舰跑车，也是 20 世纪 90 年代标志性 Supra 的现代继承者。经过七年的运行，2026 年将是其最后一年。与其前身一样，GR Supra 拥有强大的 382 马力发动机、引人入胜的驾驶体验和可用的手动变速箱。该车的俯冲造型仍然是道路上最独特的形状之一。
GR Supra 的终结并不一定是因为销售缓慢。丰田汽车是与宝马制造合作伙伴关系的一部分，宝马也销售了相关的 Z4 敞篷跑车。随着 Z4 生产的结束，Supra 已经没有办法继续生产了。虽然 Supra 的继任者可能正在开发中，但这款 GR Supra 很容易成为未来的经典。
作为最早量产的电动汽车之一，Model S 将在汽车历史上永远占有一席之地。然而，2026 年是最后一个车型年。Model S 的长寿使其成为豪华电动汽车的后起之秀，但它是一款宽敞的电动轿车，非常适合日常驾驶和长途公路旅行。
基础款 Model S 配备全轮驱动系统，EPA 估计续航里程为 410 英里，动力充足，可在特斯拉引用的 3.1 秒内从零加速到 60 英里/小时。购买 Model S 而非竞争对手的另一个原因是特斯拉的全自动驾驶功能，只要驾驶员准备好在需要时进行控制，该功能就可以在大多数道路上实现自动驾驶。特斯拉不再在其网站上销售新款 Model S 轿车，但仍提供二手版本。
二手 2026 年 Model S 定价：起价约为 110,000 美元
如果您正在市场上购买其中一款车辆，请迅速行动，因为剩余库存可能有限。
这个故事是由汽车网站埃德蒙兹提供给美联社的。
Michael Cantuis 是 Edmunds 的撰稿人。

item.title: 诉讼旨在禁止特朗普媒体对提前阅读总统有关美国政策的帖子收费
item.description:
纽约（美联社）——唐纳德·特朗普总统周三在联邦法院被起诉，目的是阻止他通过他的 Truth Social 公司的一项新的付费服务赚钱，该服务提供早期、独家访问他关于美国政策的帖子。
该诉讼称，为付费客户提供预览他有关美国战争、关税和其他问题政策的帖子的服务违反了宪法，并且官方公告应同时向所有人发布。本月早些时候推出的新订阅服务向华尔街公司收取每月高达 10 万美元的费用，以抢在其他公司之前交易影响市场的帖子。
“一位总统为了自己控制的一家私人公司的利益而出售他自己制作的新闻的优先权，这是如此公然的腐败和违宪，这在几年前甚至很难理解，”新闻自由基金会的倡导负责人塞思·斯特恩（Seth Stern）说，他与新闻媒体 The Intercept 一起是本案的原告。
Truth Social 的母公司 Trump Media & Technology 表示，向交易者出售快速访问权限在该行业很常见，原告只是想让总统闭嘴。
该公司在一份声明中表示：“特朗普总统的信息通过无数平台和新闻媒体传播，其中许多平台和新闻媒体都提供订阅 API。”该声明使用了快速访问服务的缩写。“现在，左翼活动人士正试图错误地利用法院武器来再次审查他并伤害我们的股东。”
推出抢先体验服务之际，上市公司特朗普媒体 (Trump Media) 每个季度亏损数亿美元，其股价在两年前上市后不久就从 62 美元跌至 10 美元以下。
原告指控该服务违反了宪法的两个部分：第一修正案与其他新闻界和公众成员平等地获取总统评论的权利，以及第五修正案禁止对政府福利收取不合理的条件。
该诉讼要求特朗普媒体被迫终止名为 Truth API 的新付费服务，该服务可将访问速度提高几毫秒。
特朗普媒体还受益于与特朗普达成的一项协议，该协议赋予其真相社交网站六小时的独家访问权限，然后他才能将其分发到其他地方。原告似乎也瞄准了这一点，要求法院阻止他在自己的网站上“专门发布官方政府信息”。
特朗普是特朗普媒体的最大股东，通过信托持有其超过40%的股份。
甚至在本月早些时候启动新的 API 服务之前，道德监管机构就批评特朗普在 Truth Social 上发帖，称其为从总统职位上获利的鲁莽尝试，与其他赚钱企业（包括与加密货币相关的企业）类似。今年早些时候，总统提交了一份年度财务披露报告，显示他去年从其政府监管的新加密货币业务中获得了超过 10 亿美元的收入。
自特朗普连任以来采取的其他举措包括，特朗普的数字金融公司 World Liberty Financial 从一家与阿拉伯联合酋长国政府有关联的公司获得了 5 亿美元的投资，并向他的粉丝和可能寻求联邦政府恩惠的人出售了价值数亿美元的特殊纪念特朗普模因硬币，其中包括一名亿万富翁，他正在应对一场联邦诉讼，该诉讼后来被暂停，然后和解。
除了总统之外，在纽约南区提起的诉讼还将他的副幕僚长丹尼尔·斯卡维诺（Daniel Scavino）和他的行政助理娜塔莉·J·哈普（Natalie J. Harp）列为被告。

item.title: 通胀放缓，但由于伊朗战争和人工智能支出推高价格，物价仍居高不下
item.description:
WASHINGTON (AP) — U.S. inflation declined slightly last month as the cost of gas and groceries slipped, though prices are still rising more quickly than before theIran war, posing challenges for the White House as the midterm elections near.
Consumer prices increased 3.4% in July from a year ago, down slightly from 3.5% in June,the Labor Department said Wednesday. Inflation had fallen to 2.4% before the Iran war. On a monthly basis, prices rose just 0.1% from June to July.
The mild decrease is the second straight decline after sharply higher gas prices pushed inflation to 4.2% in May, a three-year high. Yet even with the pause, prices are still rising more quickly than average wages, underscoring the struggle many Americans have had paying for groceries, gas, and healthcare. And many costs grew last month, including airfares, computers, and used cars.
Excluding the volatile food and energy categories, core inflation slipped to 2.5% in July from a year ago, down from 2.6% in June. July’s figure matches a post-pandemic low reached in January and February, before the Iran war.
Core prices rose 0.2% from June to July. Monthly increases at about 0.2% would be low enough over time to bring inflation closer to the Fed’s 2% goal.
“America still has an inflation problem, but there are encouraging signs that price pressures outside of the gas pump are easing,” Heather Long, chief economist at Navy Federal Credit Union, said.
Cooler inflation could also ease pressure on theFederal Reserveto raise their key interest rate to combat rising costs. Fed officials are sharply split over their next steps. Roughly half the members of the central bank’s rate-setting committee support raising borrowing costs this year, while another half think rates are already high enough to slowly push inflation back to their 2% target.
“We’re clearly not out of the woods, however it makes the Fed’s decision a little bit easier, because now you see that inflation is creeping down,” said Dan North, senior economist at Allianz Trade North America.
Still, oil prices remain elevated and gas prices rose in late July and August, suggesting overall inflation could accelerate next month. On Wednesday, gas averaged $4.04 a gallon nationwide, 16 cents higher than a month ago, according to the motor club AAA.
Inflation has been pushed higher by a series of shocks to the economy, including President Donald Trump’stariffsimposed last spring, higher gas prices stemming from the U.S attack on Iran, and a surge in investment inartificial intelligence infrastructurethat has boosted computer chip prices. The key question for the inflation-fighters at the Federal Reserve — not to mention for consumers struggling with high gas and grocery prices — is how quickly those one-time effects will fade or whether they will lead to persistently rising prices.
Some companies, however, are still struggling with higher costs from Trump’s tariffs.
Julie Robbins, CEO of Earthquaker Devices, an Akron, Ohio-based maker of pedals used to create effects for guitars, said her company has paid $200,000 in tariffs this year and has had to raise prices twice to offset the costs.
Only a small amount of those tariffs have been refunded after the Supreme Court struck down Trump’s emergency duties. Robbins is worried they will have to raise prices again as the White House has sought to impose new tariffs to replace the ones that lost due to the Supreme Court decision.
Her company’s electric bills have also risen in recent months and the rising costs of fuel have pushed up her shipping costs.
“I am just seeing more and more costs going up all the time,” Robbins said. “The money we paid on tariffs, that easily could have paid for two or three more employees.”
Wednesday’s report showed that gasoline prices fell 2.9% from June to July, and even grocery prices declined slightly, falling by 0.1%. Yet gas prices are 25% higher than a year ago. And groceries are 2.7% more expensive than a year earlier.
Hotel room prices dropped 2.8% from June to July, likely reflecting the end of the World Cup tournament. Clothing costs rose just 0.1%, though they are up 3.9% in the past year.
Other things are growing more expensive: Computer prices jumped 3.5% from June to July, reflecting a decision by Apple to sharply raise prices for its computers and tablets asAI spendingpushes up the cost of semiconductors. Smartphone prices rose 1.1%.
Airline fares rose 2.2% from June to July as jet fuel prices spiral higher along with oil.
Price increases have stayed above the Fed’s 2% target for more than five years, suggesting there is more than temporary factors at play.
The cost of services such as healthcare, restaurant meals, and car maintenance rose 3% in July from a year earlier, and they aren’t particularly sensitive to gas prices or AI investment. Rising costs for services often reflect higher wages, as companies charge more to offset the cost of higher pay. But incomes aren’t growing fast enough to sustain inflation, economists note.
It’s a confounding situation that has left many economists — and Fed officials — seeking more information to determine where inflation is headed.
“You’ve got all these things that are just not the way the economy used to behave,” Diane Swonk, chief economist at KPMG, said.
For many consumers, years of sharply rising grocery prices have led them to adopta wide range of coping strategies, from comparison shopping, to couponing, to cutting back on favorite foods.
Retailers, including Walmart, have responded by rolling back food prices, a trend that could have lowered July’s inflation figures. Yet many other businesses are still passing on higher costs.
Paint company Sherwin-Williams is planning an 8% price increase in September to offset higher raw material costs, CEO Heidi Petz said late last month.
“We are seeing the impact of higher oil and related cost pressures, and we expect continued volatility throughout the balance of the year,” she said.
AP Writer Anne D’Innocenzio contributed to this report from New York.

item.title: 研究表明，美国宇航局登月测试的防辐射背心可以减少宇航员在太阳风暴中的暴露
item.description:
佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角（美联社）——一项新的研究表明，在美国宇航局首次阿耳忒弥斯登月期间在人体模型上测试的防护背心可以大大减少月球宇航员在严重太阳风暴期间受到的辐射暴露。
周三，科学家们报告了 2022 年女性测试假人在月球周围穿着的辐射屏蔽背心。阿耳忒弥斯一号的首次飞行中没有人登上月球，这为人类期待已久的四名飞越月球机组人员于 4 月重返月球铺平了道路。
当美国宇航局致力于月球基地时，辐射仍然是宇航员面临的最大威胁之一。美国、德国和以色列的研究小组在《科学进展》杂志上报道称，当太阳风暴袭来时，防护服可以保证月球宇航员的安全，甚至可以让他们在必要时走出避难所冒险。
该背心的一个版本此前曾在国际空间站进行过测试。它没有与阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员一起旅行，因为这是一次为期 10 天的短暂任务，空间有限，但最终可能会成为未来登月宇航员的随身携带物品。
该背心仅在高辐射和可能致癌的太阳活动期间穿着，它覆盖了最脆弱的人体器官和组织：肺、胃、骨髓、乳房和卵巢。人们认为女性特别容易患辐射诱发的癌症。
阿耳忒弥斯一号携带了两个女性人体模型，它们花了近一个月的时间往返月球。这两个人体模型被称为“佐哈尔”和“赫尔加”，从头部到下躯干的每一个都是真人大小的，它们被绑在美国宇航局猎户座太空舱的乘客座椅上。
佐哈尔穿着重 57 磅（26 公斤）的 AstroRad 背心，该背心由美国-以色列初创公司 StemRad 和洛克希德·马丁公司开发。两家公司已经在空间站上测试了原型的舒适性和功能，并按照核灾难小组所穿的装备进行建模。
赫尔加没有背心飞行，但就像它的同伴包含数千个辐射传感器一样。
该研究的主要作者 StemRad 的乔丹·胡里 (Jordan Houri) 称其为“有史以来为确定宇航员在近地轨道以外的辐射暴露而进行的最大规模的实验”。美国宇航局、德国航空航天中心和以色列航天局提供了资金。由于地球的保护性大气层和磁场，对于离家较近的太空旅行者来说，辐射暴露要少得多。
阿尔忒弥斯一号没有遇到重大的太阳爆发。但根据美国宇航局猎户座太空舱快速穿过范艾伦辐射带内部时收集的测量数据，胡里和他的团队模拟了在极端太阳粒子事件（例如 1972 年和 1989 年引爆磁性水雷并导致电网崩溃的事件）期间背心能提供多少保护。
对 NASA 来说幸运的是，1972 年的太阳爆发发生在当年两次登月之间，使阿波罗 16 号和 17 号的宇航员免受潜在致命辐射的伤害。
最新研究结果表明，在像 1972 年那样猛烈的太阳风暴中，该背心可以将宇航员的辐射剂量减少约 60%，在 1989 年的灾难中减少近 40%。科学家们指出，这分别相当于 193 天和 131 天的不必要的深空辐射暴露。
虽然阿波罗登月计划没有一次超过两周，但美国宇航局设想的月球基地停留时间可能会持续几周甚至几个月，从而增加了遭受危险太阳风暴的风险。如果 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克实现了在这颗红色星球上建造城市的目标，火星探险将持续更长时间——数月、数年，甚至可能持续一生。
科学家们正在利用他们的观察结果在不牺牲保护的情况下减轻背心的重量。他们还在研究如何对航天器上已有的物品进行辐射屏蔽——回收可以挽救宇航员的生命。
胡里预计短期内不需要进行进一步的深空测试，因为佐哈尔和赫尔加“为我们提供了异常庞大的高保真数据集”。
佐哈尔和她的背心现在在佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心展出，他们的月球之旅就是从那里开始的。
美联社健康与科学部得到霍华德休斯医学院科学教育部和罗伯特伍德约翰逊基金会的支持。美联社对所有内容全权负责。
